description:
**Project Role :** Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low\-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  

**Must have skills :** Collibra Data Governance  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Packaged or Software as a Service Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or cloud\-based applications to tailor features according to evolving business requirements. The role includes managing software releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the systems. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low\-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with stakeholders to understand needs and adapt applications accordingly is a key part of daily activities.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become a subject matter expert.
* Required active participation and contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and implement application enhancements.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal operation.
* Document configuration changes and maintain detailed records of system modifications.
* Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on application usage and best practices.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Collibra Data Governance.
* Experience with configuring and managing SaaS applications using APIs and low\-code platforms.
* Strong understanding of application lifecycle management including release management and version control.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve system stability and performance issues effectively.
* Familiarity with integration techniques to ensure compatibility across various software components.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Collibra Data Governance.


\- This position is based at our BDC14A \- STPI location.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education
